summary: This section explains how shares in a Producer Company can be transferred or given to someone else. Normally shares cannot be transferred, but members can transfer them to another active member with board approval. It also covers what happens to a member's shares after their death or if they stop being a producer.
points: Members generally cannot transfer their shares in a Producer Company.
A member can transfer shares and special rights to an active member at par value if the Board approves in advance.
Every member must nominate a person within three months of joining to receive their shares if they die.
A nominee gets the rights to the shares upon the member's death, and the Board must transfer the shares to them.
If a member stops being a primary producer or loses their qualifications, the Board can order them to surrender their shares after giving them notice and a hearing.
example: Rohan joined GreenValley Producer Company Limited and became a member. Within two months, Rohan nominated his sister Priya, as specified in the company articles, to receive his shares if he passed away. Later, Rohan decided to sell part of his shares to Anita, who was already an active member of the same company. Rohan first obtained the previous approval from the Board of Directors. Following the rules, Rohan transferred those shares to Anita at par value. Meanwhile, another member, Suresh, stopped working as a primary producer. The Board sent Suresh a written notice and gave him a chance to speak before directing him to surrender his shares back to the company.

terms.meaning: A specific type of company formed by primary producers as outlined in the law.
A member who actively participates in the business and activities of the Producer Company.
A person chosen by a member to receive their shares and rights upon the member's death.
The face value of a share without any premium or discount.

watch: A common confusion is thinking a nominee can always keep the shares, but if the nominee is not a producer, the shares must be surrendered.
